title: Hispanics flock to this university. It let campus police double as ICE agents.
description: Leaders of Florida International University signed an agreement to deputize its school police as immigration agents. Some wish they had put up more of a fight.

title: Secret contracts reveal undisclosed terms in Trump’s drug-pricing deals
description: Agreements with Pfizer and Eli Lilly include tariff protections, overseas pricing inducements and broad confidentiality clauses.

title: Trump is sober about the midterm prospects for Republicans, advisers say
description: In private, President Trump has been hearing blunt news from advisers about the GOP's poor chances in the midterms and has accepted that some of the problem is of his making.

title: How anti-Muslim rhetoric is influencing the pivotal Michigan Senate race
description: Attacks aimed at Democrat Abdul El-Sayed have brought back painful memories for some in a contest that has raised questions about the acceptability of Islamophobia in politics.

title: How did the GOP wrangle its slim House majority? Ask Rep. Tom Emmer.
description: The Republican whip describes how he worked to get the president's agenda through a closely divided House without burning bridges or losing his sense of humor.

title: Vought pushes for scrutiny of NIH grants in Oval Office clash
description: A heated debate took place in the Oval Office on Friday, with some Trump officials accusing the National Institutes of Health of funding grants that conflict with the president’s agenda.

title: Trump hails Greenland security deal that falls short of takeover
description: The agreement, which Danish officials said is not final, stops far short of Trump's often-stated goal of taking possession of the territory.

title: Trump says he will demand drug companies split up vaccines into more doses
description: Those comments came a day after Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. told attendees of a conference for the anti-vaccine group he founded that they have a “friend at the White House.”

title: Judge is skeptical Trump administration has fully abandoned payout fund
description: Officials dropped plans for a $1.8 billion fund to pay those who claimed they were wronged by the justice system. But a suit against the effort is ongoing.

title: Black congressional leaders endorse James Talarico in Texas Senate race
description: Talarico has strong support among Black voters in public polls, but he has recently stepped up his efforts to reach them.

title: Trump says son has paid back Russian for wedding party
description: The president defended Donald Trump Jr.’s decision to take a large gift from Umar Kremlev, saying that such presents are “common.”

title: Trump criticizes Republican who said immigration enforcement had ‘gone too far’
description: Rep. María Elvira Salazar (R) is running in a Latino-heavy district in Florida.

title: Spanberger takes unusual step to limit data centers — up to a point
description: Spanberger acts to restrict new data centers in Virginia but leaves some details for the future.

title: California governor signs order pushing for an AI ‘kill switch’
description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom, a likely 2028 presidential contender, said he had to act because the federal government hasn’t done enough to regulate AI.

title: Vance campaigns in deep-red territory, highlighting risks for GOP
description: JD Vance went for a campaign twofer on Friday: He visited  a deep-red district in a swing state where the GOP desperately needs to mobilize voters. It’s also the state that happens to be the first to get a say in who will be the 2028 Republican nominee.

title: What happened under the Trump administration this week
description: Trump and his administration continue to push vaccine skepticism.

title: NAACP files lawsuit seeking to bar federal agents from polling places
description: The lawsuit is the second one this month aimed at keeping ICE and others away from the polls.

title: The nativist provocateur who keeps pushing the Texas GOP further right
description: Republican leaders criticized a recent post by Bo French attacking South Asian UT students. But many in the party have felt compelled to embrace parts of his ideology.

title: More U.S. troops have died amid Iran war than Pentagon has disclosed publicly
description: Officials who spoke with The Post expressed frustration that the additional loss of life in the Middle East is not reflected in the Defense Department’s casualty database.

title: These midterm polls caught our attention this week. They’re good for Democrats.
description: Political strategists and pollsters say surveys are usually more reliable after Labor Day.

title: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
description: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

title: Build columns, not Trump’s arch, D.C. official tells administration
description: Local officials, preservationists and historians are pushing to scale back Trump's planned arch, advocating the slender columns originally envisioned by architects and lawmakers a century ago.

title: Congress is getting older, and Americans aren’t happy
description: This was a significant week in the debate about aging politicians.

title: For now, Pentagon plan for testosterone testing will apply to male troops only
description: Newly updated guidelines would test male service members aged 30 and over for low testosterone. Rules for females will be released later, officials said.

title: She’s survived four gerrymanders and a car crash. Can her luck hold?
description: Rep. Marcy Kaptur (D-Ohio), 80, has been unbeatable, even as her district gets redrawn again and again.

title: Most Michigan voters disapprove of Trump’s tariffs on Canada, poll shows
description: Among the state’s independents, who could determine the outcome of several key midterm races, 68 percent disapprove of Trump's levies on Canadian products.

title: Why Democrats are starting to feel bullish about a midterm wave
description: Democrats say the Iran war, high prices and President Donald Trump's sinking popularity give them a real chance of congressional majorities.

title: White House withdraws nomination of Lance Schroyer to lead ICE
description: President Trump's nominee to lead U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement was former Oklahoma state trooper Lance Schroyer. Three months after tapping him for the job, his name is being withdrawn.

title: How Google is drafting AI chatbot laws around the country
description: As states push to regulate chatbots, tech companies are trying to write safety rules in ways that exempt some of their key products.

title: Republican 'cavalry' arrives with a Trump-backed $150 million ad blitz in key races
description: To counter a difficult political environment, two Trump-aligned super PACs have reserved more than $150 million in ads — primarily in deep red House and Senate races that have now become competitive.

title: A DHS email raises new questions about the Trump administration's election plans
description: A heavily redacted email from last year, reported first by NPR, reveals that DHS personnel shared a list of jurisdictions that offer election materials in non-English languages. It's unclear why.

title: Some GOP candidates are still making election fraud claims. Voters want to move on
description: President Trump and some Republican battleground candidates are still embracing false claims about widespread election fraud in 2020, even as many GOP voters want them to move on.

title: Republican candidate in Florida runs ads criticizing Trump's immigration enforcement
description: In a rare move, a House Republican running in a competitive race in South Florida is publicly breaking with President Trump. Maria Elvira Salazar represents a majority Hispanic district.

title: Texas Republican candidate under fire for comment about university students of color
description: A Texas Republican's complaint that too many people of color were in a video of the crowd at a University of Texas football game set off condemnations.

title: Trump's week of setbacks: The president's priorities get rare pushback
description: President Trump's agenda has run into rare institutional pushback on a variety of issues from mail-in voting to the Federal Reserve.

title: What do Trump's supporters think of the political pushback he's faced
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Will Sommer of The Bulwark about the pushback President Trump has faced at home and abroad on some of his policies and initiatives.

title: RFK Jr. says Americans worried about vaccines have a ‘friend at the White House’
description: Since being confirmed as health secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has made clear he wants to overhaul the nation’s immunization system.

title: Senator blocks bill meant to lower electricity prices linked to data centers
description: Sen. Martin Heinrich (D-New Mexico) halted passage of a proposal that had passed the House by an overwhelming margin.

title: What to know about the Kennedy Center closing under Trump
description: His allies have warned that it could be permanent if his name is not added to the iconic arts venue.

title: U.S. will let Iranian leaders attend U.N. General Assembly in New York
description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is scheduled to address the annual gathering of world leaders on Wednesday.

title: Democrats seize on House GOP’s decision to leave town early
description: The Republican-led chamber has no more workdays scheduled in Washington before the November midterms.

title: Mike Pence says he has ‘no plans’ to run for president in 2028
description: Mike Pence says he has no plans to run for president in 2028.

title: Why Karl Rove, a father of the modern Texas GOP, is voting for a Democrat
description: How Texas Republicans abandoned their immigrant-welcoming tradition.

title: The Pollwatcher: Inside The Washington Post-Schar School poll on Michigan
description: Plus: AI layoff fears and measles vaccine trust.

title: Democrats demand to know where Venezuelan oil revenue is going
description: The Trump administration seized control of Venezuelan oil after capturing President Nicolás Maduro in January.
